verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that Langfuse serves a live llms.txt at langfuse.com/llms.txt and markdown versions of its docs (e.g. /docs.md, plus .md doc URLs throughout the pack). It also documents a Docs MCP server built for Cursor and other coding agents to consume its documentation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on reports of agents successfully using these docs, and evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
